economic_hypothesis: Among otherwise tradable firms, a shorter lag between fiscal year end and the public 10-K acceptance date proxies for operating and reporting efficiency. A monthly long-fastest, short-slowest portfolio may earn a positive net spread.

signal_definition.reporting_lag_days: calendar days from report_date through SEC acceptance date
signal_definition.decision_clock: last regular XNYS close of the prior calendar month plus 30 minutes
signal_definition.entry: second regular XNYS open of the formation month
signal_definition.exit: second regular XNYS open of the following month
signal_definition.sort: cross-sectional deterministic quintiles by reporting_lag_days ascending, accession then ticker tie-break
signal_definition.position: equal-weight long shortest-lag quintile at 100 percent NAV and short longest-lag quintile at 100 percent NAV, dollar neutral at 200 percent gross exposure

formal_tests.primary: mean monthly fastest-minus-slowest return net of 30 bps one-way turnover cost
formal_tests.stress: mean monthly fastest-minus-slowest return net of 50 bps one-way turnover cost
formal_tests.inference: Newey-West monthly mean test with lag 3
formal_tests.multiplicity: Bonferroni screen using at least the disclosed global trial floor

hard_claim_limits: The historical universe is selected from 2026 survivors and lacks delisting returns and permanent security identifiers.
Historical accelerated-filer status and the paper's contemporaneous 750 million dollar market-cap screen are unavailable.
SEC API acceptance timestamps have not been reconciled to raw accession SGML headers.
Yahoo adjusted opens can be retrospectively revised and are not execution-grade quotes.
Historical borrow, financing and TAQ impact are absent.
The original paper PDF was not directly inspected; this is a paper-inspired proxy based on its public abstract and a secondary methodology summary.
The 2025 cohort must remain signal-only until a separately frozen reveal decision.
